title: What are clouds made of?
examples: Teacher, are clouds made of water?
How do clouds stay up in the sky?
Where does the rain come from?

explain.say: Clouds are made of very tiny little drops of water.
These tiny drops are so light they float up high in the sky.
When the drops get too heavy, they fall down to the ground.
When the drops fall down, we see it as rain falling from the sky.
In real life, when you see a cloud, remember those tiny water drops floating up.
A common mistake is thinking clouds are just big piles of water.

faq.q: Are clouds made of actual water?
faq.a: No, they are made of very tiny drops of water that are floating. You might also hear people ask if they are made of steam or if they are like cotton balls.

faq.q: Why do they float so high up?
faq.a: They float because the water drops are so small and light. Sometimes the air helps them float up to the sky.

faq.q: Does everything that falls from a cloud become rain?
faq.a: Not everything. Sometimes they fall as snow or as little bits of ice. Rain is just one way the water falls.
asks: What else can fall from clouds?

faq.q: Are clouds always in the sky?
faq.a: Clouds are usually in the sky, but they can sometimes be seen very close to the ground. They need air to float.
asks: Can clouds be on the ground?

faq.q: Do clouds get bigger when they float?
faq.a: Yes, they can get bigger as the tiny drops bump into each other. When they get too big, they fall down.

facts: Clouds are made of tiny water droplets or ice crystals.
Warm, moist air helps these tiny drops float up high.
When the drops combine and get too heavy, they fall as precipitation like rain.
Rain is water that has fallen from the clouds back to Earth.

quiz.why: This is right because clouds are made of very small amounts of water that float up high.

wrong.0: This is tempting because puddles are water, but clouds are much smaller drops.
wrong.1: This is tempting because they look fluffy, but they are actually tiny drops.
wrong.2: This is tempting because mist is water, but clouds are higher up in the sky.

quiz.say: When do the tiny water drops fall to Earth?
quiz.why: The drops fall because they collect so much water that they become too heavy to float anymore.

wrong.0: This is wrong because cold air can change them, but weight is what makes them fall.
wrong.2: This is wrong because the sun helps them float, but it does not make them fall.
wrong.3: This is wrong because wind can blow them, but it is not the main reason they fall.

quiz.say: If the drops fall, what do we usually see?
quiz.why: Rain is the common name for the water that falls from the clouds back to us on the ground.

wrong.1: Mist is usually low to the ground, not falling from high clouds.
wrong.2: Steam is water that is hot and rising, not falling from the sky.
wrong.3: While they can be ice, rain is the most common thing we see falling.
